units: Sot. 10ᵇ בה׳ בישר וכ׳ with the word hakker (Gen. XXXVII, 32) he brought the news to his father, with hakker did they &c. (Gen. XXXVIII, 25).
Gen. R. s. 85 (the account of Tamar follows that of the sale of Joseph) כדי לסמוך ה׳ לה׳ in order to let one hakker follow the other hakker.—ה׳ פנים partiality.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30:24">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 23:23">Prov. XXIII, 23</cite>).
